text:
Samir Gupta: Heads-up: scheduling maintenance for az6-gpu-batch (~60 GPUs) next Sun 00:30-02:30 UTC. Objective: thermal calibration + NIC microcode + PDU micro-updates.
Clara Voss: Thanks. Planned as soft drains?
Samir Gupta: Yes — soft drains in 6-node cohorts. Sequence: cordon -> drain -> thermal probe -> nvlink/PCIe sanity -> uncordon. Cohorts every 5m to keep overlap minimal.
Ibrahim Noor: Recommend canary first: 2 nodes with full perf-suite (500 sample prompts) and ECC checks. Abort on any ECC/MCE.
SRE-Maya: Agree. Routing policy: cap cross-az failover to 10% and ramp over 90s per cohort. Also pre-seed KV cache on backfill nodes 25m prior.
Clara Voss: If we push to us-west1 burst, estimated extra GPU-hours ~30h. At $3.20/hr that's ~$96. Finance OK?
SRE-Maya: Fine. Tag billing as "infra-maint-az6-2026Q1".
Samir Gupta: Ops checklist: post tenant comms (24h + 1h), canary ready, oncall assigned, routing cap configured, backfill preseeded, runbook locked.
Clara Voss: Draft tenant comms: 
```
Maintenance notice: Sun 00:30-02:30 UTC in az6. Impact: brief capacity reduction for az6-gpu-batch. We will perform staggered node reboots and NIC microcode updates in 6-node cohorts. Some requests may be routed or queued briefly. Reply with tenant id if you need reserved capacity.
```
Ibrahim Noor: Add "expect short tail-latency spikes (up to 25s) during cohort validation".
Samir Gupta: Added.
SRE-Maya: Oncall please: @ops-bot schedule.
ops-bot: Scheduled oncall: Primary - SRE-Maya, Backup - Ibrahim Noor for 2026-03-29 00:30 UTC window.
Samir Gupta: Can someone run capacity sim with current queued jobs (fairness + priority) and paste numbers? Threshold for two-region failover = queued > 220 units.
Clara Voss: Running sim...
Clara Voss: Sim result: peak queued 210 units, projected GPU util 92% during cohort 7. Under threshold but close.
Ibrahim Noor: Keep an eye on cohort 6-8; if queued >215 move to pre-warmed fallback nodes in us-west1.
SRE-Maya: Canary run commands and drain snippets: 
```
kubectl cordon <node>
kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120 --timeout=8m
```
Ibrahim Noor: Validation greps: `journalctl -k | grep -i nvlink`, `dmesg | grep -E "MCE|PCIe|thermal"`, and `nvidia-smi -q | grep -i ecc`. Auto-rollback on ECC >0 or thermal > threshold.
Samir Gupta: Also run `curl -sS https://runbook.internal/infra/az6-maint | jq .steps` before starting.
SRE-Maya: Pre-seed plan: spin 8 backfill GPUs with low-priority seed jobs 30m before window to prime KV cache. That should cut token cost during rehousing.
Clara Voss: Ops cost approved and finance tag added. I'll post 24h comms shortly.
Ibrahim Noor: I'll prepare the canary pack and perf script.
Samir Gupta: Great. Final checklist: comms posted, canary green, oncall confirmed, finance tag set, runbook ready. Ping when 24h notice is live. :thumbsup:
